hook.text: She spent three hours choosing a font for a report due in two. The content never got written at all.

buildup.text: Perfectionism disguises itself as high standards. Underneath, it is often fear of being judged for imperfect work.

discovery.text: Done is better than perfect is not about low quality. It means shipping version one so you can improve version two.

twist.text: Perfectionists often produce less, not more. The constant revision loop means fewer finished projects over a career.

climax.text: Set a 'good enough' threshold before you start. When you hit it, stop refining and move to the next thing.

punchline.text: Ship it imperfect. Fix it later. Ship it now.

quiz.question: Why does perfectionism often reduce output?
options: Constant revision prevents finishing, so fewer projects ship
